scheme_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
scheme_name_english: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority, Government of India
beneficiary: Eligible families identified under the scheme's current beneficiary database and applicable rules
benefits: Cashless and paperless hospitalisation for eligible secondary and tertiary care
Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year, subject to scheme rules
eligibility: Eligibility is based on the official PM-JAY beneficiary database and current government rules.
application_process: Check eligibility through the official PM-JAY portal or an authorised Ayushman service point/empanelled facility.
source_type: National Health Authority, Government of India
